name: Transdroid
tagline: Control your torrent downloads from anywhere
description:
Transdroid is the remote control for the torrent program running on your computer or home server. Check what is downloading, see the speeds, pause or start things, look inside a torrent to pick which files you actually want, and add new ones without getting up.

It talks to most of the popular clients — Transmission, qBittorrent, Deluge, rTorrent, Vuze, µTorrent and many more. You can add torrents through the built-in search or from RSS feeds, and keep an eye on progress with a home screen widget or a background check that tells you when something finishes.

You need a torrent client already running somewhere the phone can reach it. Transdroid does not download anything itself.
